nodes.label: Maintain Table Statistics with VACUUM and ANALYZE
nodes.source_location: ## Maintain Table Statistics with VACUUM and ANALYZE
nodes.rationale: The planner chooses strategies from statistics; stale statistics make a 1M-row table look like 1000 rows and yield a Seq Scan where an Index Scan would win. VACUUM reclaims space, ANALYZE refreshes the estimates.

nodes.label: Autovacuum Scale-Factor Tuning for High-Churn Tables
nodes.rationale: Defaults (20% dead tuples to vacuum, 10% change to analyze) are too lax for busy tables; lowering the scale factors per table keeps statistics fresh where churn is highest without paying that cost everywhere.
